acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000
collision energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
instrument: coupled directly to a Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled directly to a Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer using the proxeon nanoflow source in positive ion mode.
labeling: results are represented as the percentage of peptide counts corresponding to each Mascot Delta score category
